log.hypothesis: Reference is IR-safe for sub-threshold soft particles: f_ref(jet+photon at 1e-4) ~ f_orig(clean jet), while f_ref(clean)=f_orig(clean).
Original model logits on the same constructed probes, baseline for comparison with the reference; the original responds strongly to the out-of-support 1e-4 photon.
Reference removes neutral particles below a boundary in (log pT, log E); a 16x16 grid of an added photon in 8 jets maps that boundary and tests whether it depends on the jet.

Reference = original on the jet with neutral (zero-IP / pid 6,7) constituents of pT<0.8 GeV and E<~1.77 GeV removed; multiple soft photons are all removed, slot position irrelevant, charged never removed.
Original logits on P with the rule-selected soft neutrals removed should equal the reference on P (126/128 jets already match the rule).
The residual stream has a few massive, sign-constant channels shared by all tokens (attention-sink style) that I can use as a gate; the soft photon perturbs summary tokens progressively with depth.

P jets where the reference differs beyond the photon rule all contain neutral hadrons with E ~1.7-2.1 GeV, so neutral hadrons (pid 7) likely have their own, higher removal thresholds; charged are never removed; photons follow pT<0.8 & E<1.8 up to higher pT.

Zeroing embedded channel 2 exactly for pid 6/7 tokens with pT<0.8 & E<1.8 turns them into padding for body, classifier and generator; soft probes should be nearly exact (leak only via kNN local features), P partly fixed (neutral hadrons with 1.8<E<2.2 not handled).

v2 plus a time_embed unit that saturates the generator time token in the gating dim for t>0 (exactly zero at t=0); classifier metrics unchanged vs v2, gen_drift at t=0.2/0.5 should drop because the time token is no longer gated out.

Neutral hadrons are removed iff E < E7 with log E7 in (0.75,0.80), independent of pT; likely E7 = 2.2 GeV (log 0.7885).

With v3, f_edit(jet+soft neutral) should equal f_edit(jet) up to the kNN local-feature leak, which should be largest for low-multiplicity jets (n<=15) where the soft photon is a neighbour of every particle.

The ~0.009 S leak at any photon pT comes from interaction pair biases for out-of-distribution soft pairs overcoming the -30 logit gate; with a -300 gate the leak for ph1e-4/ph1e-3/nh1e-4 should fall to <0.003 S while clean is unchanged.

Locate the leak: compare unflagged token states between clean jets and the same jets plus a flagged photon under the edit; a margin violation in some head/query should show as a difference appearing at a specific depth and growing.
The clean-vs-photon difference under the edit appears at a specific late block (15-27), either from a margin violation or from the flagged token's gating value losing saturation.
Classifier blocks 1-3 gates were built from proxy query statistics; some heads may have q.e+G<0 for real queries, boosting flagged keys by ~T, which would explain why T=300 leaks more than T=30.

v5 = v3 with near-dead embed units, classifier gates built from real edited queries (removes the block-3 margin violation), natural-margin k-only gates for 681/1024 heads and better gate directions for the rest; lower clean floor and leak than v3 at smaller DoF.

v6 = v5 with classifier dim-579 writes kept (classifier gates use natural directions orthogonal to W_q[:,d]) and the gate units scaled to output eps instead of zeroing their fc2 columns; similar E_ref with lower clean floor and DoF 45k.
